name: composepress/core
description: A small WordPress plugin runtime boundary

suggest.roots/wordpress-no-content: Provides a real WP_Hook engine so ComposePress\Core\Testing\RecordingHooks can run in unit tests without loading WordPress

scripts.scope:compat: rm -rf build/compat-a build/compat-b && php vendor/bin/php-scoper add-prefix --config=scoper.compat.inc.php --prefix=ComposePressCompatA --output-dir=build/compat-a --force && php vendor/bin/php-scoper add-prefix --config=scoper.compat.inc.php --prefix=ComposePressCompatB --output-dir=build/compat-b --force && php tools/verify-scoped-compat.php
